text: Which chain of implications between classes of integral domains is correct?
explanation: A Euclidean norm lets one generate any ideal by an element of minimal norm (so ED ⇒ PID), and in a PID the ascending chain and prime = irreducible arguments give unique factorization (PID ⇒ UFD). Neither implication reverses: ℤ[(1+√−19)/2] is a non-Euclidean PID, and ℤ[x] is a UFD but not a PID.
